abilities.name: Digisoul Charge
abilities.description: Your Basic Attack gains an additional effect. When it hits, you regain Hope equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.description: Your Basic Attack's PR increases by 2.

abilities.name: All the Way In
abilities.description: The Hope you regain from Digisoul Charge doubles. You now regain Hope equal to the full damage dealt instead of half.

abilities.name: First In
abilities.description: At the start of each round, your partner Digimon can move up to 2 spaces.

abilities.name: One-Two Punch
abilities.description: Once per round, when you use your Basic Action to make your Basic Attack, you may make it twice instead of once. Resolve each attack separately, including Digisoul Charge's Hope return on each one that hits.

abilities.name: Going Down Swinging
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon is reduced to 0 HP or less, before any other effects of reaching 0 HP apply, they may immediately make one attack, using any move currently available to them. Once that attack resolves, the Cascade and every other normal effect of reaching 0 HP take place as usual.
